answer: Re-attestations are stored in pearl and ocean lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 11 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the island graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1714 impostors cost 430 times the honest price and take 9 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
